description: Returns one CMBS trust (deal) by slug or name fragment: balance and distress, parties (master and special servicer, directing certificateholder, operating advisor, trustee), every certificate class with CUSIP, coupon, balance, losses and credit support, and liquidated loans with loss severity. Use list_trusts to find a trust by name; use search_loans with trust set to a slug for the trust's loans.

trust.description: Trust slug like "benchmark-2018-b8" or a name fragment like "BANK 2019-BNK16"

title: Get one CMBS trust
